content_sections.heading: M.H. Shinde Mahavidyalaya CHB Teacher Recruitment 2026 Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, the age limit, the pay or the application fee.

content_sections.heading: About M.H. Shinde Mahavidyalaya
content_sections.text: M.H. Shinde Mahavidyalaya is a college at Tisangi in Gaganbavada taluka, Kolhapur district. It is run by Dnyansadhana Shikshan Prasarak Mandal, Nivade.

content_sections.heading: M.H. Shinde Mahavidyalaya CHB Teacher Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The post is governed by all the terms and conditions of two Government Resolutions issued by the Higher and Technical Education Department of the Government of Maharashtra: Resolution No. Sankirna-2018/(185/18)/MaShi-3, dated 14 November 2018 Resolution No. Sankirna/2021/Pr.Kr.181/21/ViShi-1, dated 17 October 2022 The conditions of the No Objection Certificate also apply. The Divisional Joint Director (Higher Education), Kolhapur Division, Kolhapur issued it on 29 May 2026 under a letter numbered 2026-27/2874258. For the eligibility for this post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview, and the post is filled by the college's Local Selection Committee.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is temporary and lasts one academic year, for a maximum of 9 months. It ends automatically after that period. The appointed teacher gets no rights of regular service. The teacher cannot later demand permanent absorption or any regular-service right. The teacher must work in only one college at a time. An undertaking confirming this, and that the teacher is not working in any other college, must be submitted to the institution or college on stamp paper of the minimum value under government rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for M.H. Shinde Mahavidyalaya CHB Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Prepare your application for the Botany post. Collect the required original documents and a set of photocopies. Be present at the institution or college on Wednesday, 4 November 2026 at 10:00 AM. Venue: M.H. Shinde Mahavidyalaya, Tisangi, Taluka Gaganbavada, District Kolhapur. Documents to carry: Application Required original documents Photocopies of the documents

faq.question: Q1. Which subject is this CHB post for?
faq.answer: The post is for Botany, and the No Objection Certificate covers 01 post in that subject.

faq.question: Q2. How long will the appointment last?
faq.answer: It lasts one academic year, for a maximum of 9 months, and then ends automatically.

faq.question: Q3. Can this appointment lead to a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the appointee gets no regular-service rights and cannot demand to be made permanent in future.

faq.question: Q4. What should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Bring your application with the required original documents and their photocopies.

faq.question: Q5. Can I teach at another college at the same time?
faq.answer: No. The appointed teacher must give an undertaking on stamp paper stating that they work in only one college at a time.

faq.question: Q6. Which rules govern this recruitment?
faq.answer: The Maharashtra Government Resolutions of 14 November 2018 and 17 October 2022 apply, along with the No Objection Certificate of 29 May 2026.
